root_cause: Original Gmail reply classifier performed substring unsubscribe detection on the full messageText which can include the sender's own quoted optout footer. This can convert a real positive reply into an incorrect suppression.

observed_evidence.current_sender_brand_footer: Wil je geen berichten meer van mij? Antwoord met "afmelden".

prevention: Extract only newly recipient-authored visible reply before any classification or outcome mutation; reject quoted-only messages.
Never classify the original sender's quoted unsubscribe footer or a mention of word 'afmelden' as a recipient request.
Preserve explicit direct unsubscribes as immediate suppressions and honor historical suppressed contacts.
Preserve provider message/thread IDs, reply-event exactly-once replay and existing ONE BRAIN -> Powerhouse -> Heartbeat lineage.
Keep legal marketing email authorization strict; classification repair creates no send permission, new scheduler or bulk emails.
Measure real provider reply outcomes separately from code deployment and synthetic regression success.
prevention_rule: Only the recipient's newly authored visible text may classify commercial Gmail reply intent. Prior outbound optout footer is a template, never incoming unsubscribe evidence. Empty/quoted-only reply produces no response or suppression. Provider and real contact-response readback are separate from technical deploy truth.
rollout: Protected Required + CodeQL -> protected main -> original Supabase GitHub Integration -> 1:1 provider source parity -> subsequent authorized Gmail reply source confirmation. Never claim a false historical unsubscribe without direct evidence.
